---
title: "Random Forest Survival Prediction"
format: html
editor: visual
---

# Load Libraries and Data

```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(randomForest)
library(survival)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Preparing

```{r}
# Load SKCM expression object
load("SKCM.rda")

# Extract clinical data
clinical <- colData(query2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(patient, gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
         ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = days_to_death / 365,
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & !is.na(event))

# Log2 transform expression data
log_expr <- log2(assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand") + 1)

# Match samples between clinical and expression
matched_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(log_expr))
clinical <- clinical[matched_samples, ]
log_expr <- log_expr[, matched_samples]
```

# Feature Selection

```{r}
select_top_var_genes <- function(expr, n = 1000) {
  top_genes <- names(sort(apply(expr, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE))[1:n]
  return(top_genes)
}

select_surv_genes <- function(expr, time, event, n = 50) {
  pvals <- sapply(1:nrow(expr), function(i) {
    fit <- tryCatch(coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ expr[i,]), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit)) summary(fit)$coefficients[1, 5] else 1
  })
  names(pvals) <- rownames(expr)
  top_genes <- names(sort(pvals))[1:n]
  return(top_genes)
}

top_genes <- select_top_var_genes(log_expr, 1000)
log_expr_sub <- log_expr[top_genes, ]
surv_genes <- select_surv_genes(log_expr_sub, clinical$survival_time, clinical$event, 50)
expr_final <- t(log_expr[surv_genes, ])

rf_data <- as.data.frame(expr_final) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = clinical$survival_time,
    event = clinical$event,
    gender = factor(clinical$gender),
    age_diagnosis = clinical$age_diagnosis,
    stage = factor(case_when(
      grepl("I", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Early",
      grepl("II", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Intermediate",
      grepl("III|IV", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Advanced",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  )
```

# Remove NA

```{r}
nzv <- nearZeroVar(rf_data %>% select(-survival_time, -event), names = TRUE)
rf_data <- rf_data[, setdiff(colnames(rf_data), nzv)]
rf_data <- na.omit(rf_data)
```

# Split data

```{r}
set.seed(42)
idx_event <- which(rf_data$event == 1)
idx_censored <- which(rf_data$event == 0)

train_idx <- c(
  sample(idx_event, size = round(0.7 * length(idx_event))),
  sample(idx_censored, size = round(0.7 * length(idx_censored)))
)
test_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(rf_data)), train_idx)

train_data <- rf_data[train_idx, ]
test_data <- rf_data[test_idx, ]
```

# Train Random Forest

```{r}
rf_model <- randomForest(survival_time ~ ., data = train_data %>% select(-event), ntree = 100, importance = TRUE)
test_data$predicted <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data)
```

# Evaluate Model

```{r}
c_index <- concordance(Surv(test_data$survival_time, test_data$event) ~ test_data$predicted)$concordance

test_data$surv_1yr <- with(test_data, ifelse(survival_time <= 1 & event == 1, 1, 0))
valid <- with(test_data, survival_time >= 1 | (survival_time < 1 & event == 1))
labels <- test_data$surv_1yr[valid]
scores <- test_data$predicted[valid]
valid_idx <- complete.cases(labels, scores)

roc_plot <- if (sum(valid_idx) > 10) {
  roc_obj <- roc(labels[valid_idx], scores[valid_idx], direction = "<")
  auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  ggroc(roc_obj) + geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "1-Year Mortality ROC (RF)", subtitle = paste("AUC =", round(auc_val, 3))) +
    theme_minimal()
} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Not enough samples for ROC") + theme_void()
}
```

# Output Table and Plot

```{r}
metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("C-index", "AUC (1yr)"),
  Value = c(round(c_index, 3), if (exists("auc_val")) round(auc_val, 3) else NA)
)
knitr::kable(metrics, caption = "Random Forest Model Performance")

print(roc_plot)
```
